name: two_things_at_once
title: Section C · two things at once in one stream: work beside the desk, a question answered meanwhile, a follow-up about the work, nothing opened

steps.say: In the background, go through my Listings one by one and work out each one's asking price per location, then tell me which is cheapest per location. Carry on talking with me meanwhile.
steps.reply:
I've started working through your four Listings in the background. For each one I'm dividing the asking price by the number of locations. When it's done I'll tell you which is cheapest per location and flag any listing that's missing a number.

Meanwhile, what's on your mind?

steps.say: How many eggs have I logged in total?
steps.reply:
You've logged **6 eggs** in total, across three entries in your food log: 2, 3 and 1. The only other entry is one piece of toast.

The listings work has also finished:

| Business | Asking price | Locations | Per location |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Lakeside Bakery** | 450,000 | 3 | **150,000** |
| Sunbelt Laundry | 990,000 | 6 | 165,000 |
| Corner Print Shop | 210,000 | 1 | 210,000 |
| Harbour Car Wash | 850,000 | 4 | 212,500 |

**Lakeside Bakery is the cheapest per location** at 150,000. That's 15,000 (about 9%) less than Sunbelt Laundry, the next cheapest. All four listings had an asking price

steps.say: About the listings: also tell me which one is the most expensive per location.
steps.reply: **Harbour Car Wash is the most expensive per location** at 212,500 (850,000 across 4 locations). It's only just ahead of Corner Print Shop, which costs 210,000 for its one location, a difference of 2,500. So the two are almost tied at the top.
